notes_for_editor: The Star News reprint (Dec 2015) is the only source with a build date, oversight and staffing detail. The article contradicts itself on who runs the tower (DNR Prentice station vs federal Chequamegon National Forest land), and the Forest Lookouts Wisconsin page agrees with the federal version. Not resolved; a human should check the DNR or Chequamegon-Nicolet records. The article does not say whether Rindt was staffed. The Forest Lookouts page gives a 'September 1939' photo credit to the National Archives for Rindt but no image link, so no photo was added. 'Standing' comes from the FFLA listing, with no post-2015 record. No corrections proposed: the record's county and coordinates fit the article's 'southwest of Westboro'.
